synopsis: When Ayumi learns that her senior Yuuki is heading to Minami High School, a fairly difficult institution to enroll in, she believes her current results are insufficient to pass the entrance exam. Despite this, he gives her a word of encouragement and promises to tutor her if she succeeds. One year passes, and Yuuki finds Ayumi to be one of the new first-year students enrolling at his school. Now fulfilling his promise, the two experience many events together—whether they be funny, embarrassing, or even romantic.
